name: neighborhood-intelligence-europe
description: Comprehensive neighborhood analysis for any European location — walkability, air quality, schools, flood risk, transport, cycling, safety, healthcare, noise, and more. 100% free, no API key required.
long_description:
Full neighborhood due diligence for any address in Europe using open data sources only — no API key, no subscription, no cost.

Tools across 12 domains:
• Geocoding: address resolution anywhere in Europe
• Walkability: amenity density score (0–100)
• Air Quality: EU AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, O₃ via Copernicus CAMS
• Public Transport: bus/tram/metro/train/ferry score (0–100)
• Schools: kindergarten through university listings
• Green Spaces: parks, forests, playgrounds score (0–100)
• Flood Risk: elevation + waterway proximity assessment
• Neighborhood Character: affluence & vibrancy proxy scores
• Cycling Infrastructure: dedicated lanes, bike parking (0–100)
• Safety: police, fire, hospital proximity
• Healthcare: hospitals, pharmacies, GPs, dentists
• Noise Sources: roads, rail, airport, industrial, nightlife

Data sources (all free, open):
• OpenStreetMap / Overpass API
• Nominatim (geocoding)
• Open-Meteo + Copernicus CAMS (air quality)
• Open-Meteo Elevation / NASA SRTM (flood risk)

Coverage: all of Europe. Quality depends on local OSM mapping completeness.
